last_preview.rendered_content:
Decision Subject: Amended continuation authorization for Dell Class-B Boundary-P provisioning (hac-dell / atila-Latitude-E5470, machine-id 54ff22ce400b475aa0d55cb68f4a3334): repairs Action 6 file-mode defect (D3-1), binds retained Actions-1-5 baseline as continuation precondition (D3-2), per Phase 149O.20L.7D.3 (docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7D_3_ACTION_6_FILE_MODE_CONTINUATION_BASELINE_PROPOSITION_AMENDMENT.md). No execution authorized this phase.
Template: class-b-boundary-p-provisioning-authorization
Owner: Atila Madai
Evidence: docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7B_1_DELL_BOUNDARY_P_PROPOSITION_MATERIALIZATION_AMENDMENT.md, docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7D_2_DELL_CLASS_B_REAL_HOST_PROVISIONING_EXECUTION_RETRY.md, docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7D_3_ACTION_6_FILE_MODE_CONTINUATION_BASELINE_PROPOSITION_AMENDMENT.md
Clarifications: (none)
Selected option: approve
Rationale: I approve exactly the amended continuation proposition presented for Phase 149O.20L.7D.3, including the repaired Action-6 forward/read-back/rollback command sequence, the explicitly bound retained Actions-1-5 Dell baseline, the continuation gates and STOP semantics, and unchanged Actions 7-9 and exclusions. The prior CHGR chgr-96a0ce12756e4cc892492a87af1db832 remains historical authority for the original provisioning attempt but does not authorize continuation from the current retained Actions-1-5 baseline or reuse of its defective Action-6 command. Any future continuation from the current Dell state must rely on the newly approved amended authority. This approval does not authorize execution in this phase, DeploymentBinding creation, Boundary C certification, Boundary A activation, repository onboarding, Permission Broker changes, or any other Dell mutation.
Conditions: Excludes: Action 6 execution, Actions 7-9 execution, any rerun of Actions 1-5, any Dell Class-B mutation, DeploymentBinding creation, Boundary C certification, Boundary A activation, HATP_MANDATORY activation, Cutover Record creation, Permission Broker changes, POL-005, COMP-002, arbitrary repository onboarding, and centralized multi-repository governance. This phase is analysis + proposition amendment + election + authorization publication only.
